system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Champion, Gladiator, or Duelist.

Give the target a [Duel] tag. If a person with a [Duel] tag is included in the target of your attack, +5 to the damage roll. This effect lasts at the end of the scene or until you are in a [Hidden] state. 

(CR 11):  Increase the damage by +5.
(CR 21):  Increase the damage by an additional +5.

A skill that challenges a determined opponent to a duel. A spectacular battle where you collide head-on with power is your monopoly.
